# edgeos_service_upnp (Resource)

The UPnP IGD and NAT-PMP service (`service upnp2`), which lets LAN hosts open port forwards on the WAN interface by themselves. There is one per router and the ID is always `upnp2`.

The resource owns `service upnp2`: creating it fails if UPnP is already configured (import it instead), every modelled attribute is read back, and destroying it deletes the whole node, which turns UPnP off as on a factory reset router. Options that are not modelled here (`port`, `bit-rate`) are left alone until the resource is destroyed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "edgeos_service_upnp" "this" {
  listen_on   = ["switch0"]
  wan         = "eth0.555"
  nat_pmp     = true
  secure_mode = true

  acl_rules = {
    "10" = {
      action        = "allow"
      description   = "LAN hosts, unprivileged ports only"
      subnet        = "192.168.1.0/24"
      external_port = "1024-65535"
      local_port    = "1024-65535"
    }
    "9999" = {
      action = "deny"
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `listen_on` (Set of String) LAN interfaces UPnP and NAT-PMP requests are accepted on, such as `["switch0"]`.
- `wan` (String) Interface the port forwards are opened on, such as `eth0` or `pppoe0`.

### Optional

- `acl_rules` (Attributes Map) Access control rules (`acl rule <number>`), keyed by rule number from `1` to `9999`. miniupnpd checks them in order and uses the first match. Without rules every request from `listen_on` is allowed. Rules not in the map are removed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--acl_rules))
- `nat_pmp` (Boolean) Answer NAT-PMP requests as well as UPnP (`nat-pmp enable`). Unset leaves the node out.
- `secure_mode` (Boolean) Only let a host open forwards to its own address (`secure-mode enable`). Unset leaves the node out.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `upnp2`.

<a id="nestedatt--acl_rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `acl_rules`

Required:

- `action` (String) `allow` or `deny`.

Optional:

- `description` (String) Free text description.
- `external_port` (String) WAN port or range the rule applies to, such as `1024-65535`.
- `local_port` (String) LAN port or range the rule applies to, such as `1024-65535`.
- `subnet` (String) LAN hosts the rule applies to, in CIDR notation such as `192.168.1.0/24`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = edgeos_service_upnp.this
  id = "upnp2"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import edgeos_service_upnp.example 'upnp2'
```
